scope: Occupancy construction with merging permitted. Required source walls and attribution are not implemented. No production cleaner switch.
timing_scope: Single sample; sum of per-group calls excludes loading, grouping, complete-city verification and meshing. Focused tests and short mesh audits ran concurrently. The cap counts proposals, not elapsed time.

checker_profile.scope: Same 100-candidate diagnostic on initial Lund group 1, before local-support selection; profiling overhead included. Identical final progress tuple.

mesh_scope: Direct dtcc_mesher.Coverage handoff of conforming output and surrounding ground, without another footprint cleaner. Padded occupied bounding rectangle: 2 m for examples, 10 m for cities. min_angle=20; max_edge_length=1 m for examples and 10 m for cities; remaining options default. Benchmark _mesh_metrics uses markers shifted by -1 so ground is -1 and building indices start at zero. This is flat research handoff evidence, not a rerun of the production flat/surface benchmark.
decision: Keep one constructive occupancy/coordinate prototype. Preserve its fixed contract and study remaining local minima and repeated work before adding geometry or changing limits. Production integration requires source semantics and broader acceptance; no solver or legacy fallback is introduced.

construction_work_audit.scope: Fixed proposal family, proposal order, 2000-attempt bound, fidelity budget and progress measure. Only support/coordinate preparation is lazy. No cache, fallback or production cleaner change.
construction_work_audit.sample_method: Instrumented unchanged construct; each full report matches its baseline. Repeated operation means the same exact operation and normalized geometry/coordinate map. Same-candidate counts use normalized exact WKB; invalid and unchanged candidates are excluded from candidate counts. Static fidelity counts are diagnostic only.

full_replay.mesh_validation: Not rerun: all three complete-city inputs are byte-identical to the artifacts hashed in mesh_cities. Prior direct flat mesh evidence applies to unchanged geometry.
full_replay.timing_scope: One sample of summed group construction time, excluding loading, grouping, combined city checks, plotting and meshing; not a controlled benchmark.

local_minimum.conclusion: Original input is demonstrably feasible. Current trajectory exhausts all strictly improving local choices within original fidelity. More checks alone cannot fix this state; resetting the budget violates the original contract.

construction_work_audit.decision: Keep lazy preparation and unchanged geometry decisions. Samples do not justify a cross-state cache. Next reduce the greedy obstruction to an analytic witness and derive an edit-selection or coupled-edit obligation before changing the algorithm. Source semantics remain a production prerequisite.

coupled_edit_witness.scope: Analytic analogue of the known-feasible Gothenburg obstruction, not a coordinate-preserving reduction. No proposal generator, admission rule, production cleaner or work cap changed.

continuous_pair_motion_obstruction.conclusion: No continuous allocation of the remaining horizontal vertex/wall correction works while the lower corner stays fixed. Denser allocation sampling is insufficient.

parallel_wall_model_from_original.variables: inward wall shifts s, a1, a2
parallel_wall_model_from_original.scope: Exact for these inward-moving rectangle walls only; per-vertex displacement is not a general replacement for occupied-set fidelity.

coupled_edit_witness.decision: A bounded coupled proposal must allow adjacent corners to retreat, retain the original reference and check the whole proposal for fidelity and strict defect descent. Next specify and test a small automatic coupled boundary-motion proposal; this witness is not a general construction or a city success.

coupled_motion_experiment.scope: Research replacement of three fixed motion allocations by bounded coordinated quadratic proposals. Production cleaning, contract and 2000-attempt allowance unchanged. Broad adoption gate is NOT passed.
coupled_motion_experiment.timing_scope: Single samples, summed group time excluding load/group/combine/plot/meshing; tests and focused diagnostic work ran concurrently. Not a controlled performance comparison.
coupled_motion_experiment.mesh_scope: Direct flat coverage with surrounding ground, same pinned dtcc-mesher and options as prior handoffs. Not a production surface-mesh rerun.

malmo_contact_observation.interpretation: A protected corner lies essentially on a current edge. Preserving its measured current side permits moving the edge through protected area. Current-side classification alone is not a robust original-material constraint; final fidelity correctly rejects the proposal.

coupled_motion_experiment.decision: Retain only as the current research construction, not an improved acceptance baseline or production replacement. Seven gains and six losses produce only one extra conforming group while full-city conformance falls from three to two. Next derive original-material-aware motion constraints, including near-contact side ambiguity and complete boundary segments. Do not add fallback stages, relax fidelity or raise work limits.

original_material_motion_experiment.scope: Original-material interval constraints replace current-side half-planes in the same bounded research construction. Production cleaning, contract, tolerances and work caps unchanged.
original_material_motion_experiment.timing_scope: Single summed group-time samples, excluding load/group/combine/plot/meshing. Tests and brief focused checks overlapped the start. Not a controlled performance comparison.

gothenburg_strict_core_loss_by_frame.local_origin: strict core lower bounding-box corner; translate the already computed core and both candidate geometries before difference
gothenburg_strict_core_loss_by_frame.interpretation: The loss is already present on an unchanged edge. World-coordinate overlay misses it before the proposal but detects it afterwards. Passing checker reports therefore remain numerical observations, not exact containment certificates. Resolve coordinate-frame sensitivity before stronger acceptance claims.

original_material_motion_experiment.mesh_scope: Direct flat coverage with surrounding ground, same pinned dtcc-mesher and options as prior handoffs. Not a production surface-mesh rerun.
original_material_motion_experiment.decision: Retain the material-band correction as research. It fixes the two targeted raw cases without relaxing the contract, but full-corpus conformance, coordinate-frame stability of fidelity predicates and acceptable construction cost remain open. Next reduce and correct the recorded large-coordinate overlay inconsistency, then profile repeated band intersections before another broad adoption claim. Do not add city-specific branches or fallback stages.

fixed_frame_fidelity_experiment.scope: Correct fidelity buffer/overlay arithmetic in the shared checker using one fixed original-input local frame. Research construction, production repair branches, physical tolerances and work limits are unchanged. Profile only; no performance optimization introduced.

exact_interval_reuse_trial.scope: Temporary measured experiment only; no maintained implementation change. Exact float keys, immutable band, LRU capacity 4096, one group.
exact_interval_reuse_trial.comparison_warning: Baseline used cProfile; these timings are not a controlled speedup comparison.

fixed_frame_fidelity_experiment.timing_scope: Single summed group-time samples. Excludes loading/grouping, combining cities, plotting and meshing. Not a controlled speed comparison; checker arithmetic and resulting trajectories changed. A separate reuse experiment overlapped part of the replay.

comparison_to_previous_checker.scope: Historical counts used the old checker and are not a like-for-like acceptance gate. Previously complete city geometries were separately rechecked above.

fixed_frame_fidelity_experiment.mesh_scope: Direct flat coverage with surrounding ground, same pinned dtcc-mesher and options as prior handoffs. Not a production surface-mesh rerun.

performance_profile.interpretation: Cumulative times are nested. Full admissibility scans and immutable band intersections dominate; optimizer cost is small. A 4096-entry exact-query cache hits only 866 of 260787 calls (0.33%) while preserving the entire report, so no cache is added. Next measure local extraction of the immutable band around the affected geometry; preserve one independent checker.

fixed_frame_fidelity_experiment.decision: Retain the shared fidelity arithmetic correction. Full-corpus construction acceptance and source semantics remain open. A measured exact-query cache has negligible reuse and is not adopted. Next measure restriction of band intersections to the affected spatial neighborhood, without duplicating admissibility logic or relaxing the contract.

local_band_experiment.scope: Restrict each coupled motion band to an outward-rounded box enclosing all affected edges plus the existing finite ray radius. Original band, checker, proposal ordering, caps and source policy unchanged. No cache or production change.
local_band_experiment.timing_scope: Single summed group-time samples excluding loading/grouping, combining, plotting and meshing. Tests overlapped the beginning. One representative before/after cProfile run is also recorded; these are indicative measurements, not statistical confidence intervals.
local_band_experiment.mesh_scope: Direct flat coverage with surrounding ground, same pinned dtcc-mesher and options as prior handoffs. Not a production surface-mesh rerun.
local_band_experiment.decision: Retain the seven-line spatial restriction: all 538 detailed reports match apart from time, all seven geometry artifacts and the figure are byte-identical, and runtime falls about 18% in the full replay. Close this bounded performance investigation. Next reduce one small stalled case and one dense work-limit case to general geometric obstructions before changing the construction; preserve the fixed contract and source semantics gate.

geometric_obstruction_investigation.decision: Investigation complete; no construction, checker, tolerance or cap change. Next test neighborhood clearance constraints in the existing bounded motion model. Chain replacement is a separate subsequent checkpoint.

small_stall.reference_origin: Historical fixed-allocation research construction replayed with current FidelityBudget; saved geometry rechecked independently. Historical solver is not restored.

dense_group.interpretation: Centimetre-scale sampling dominates pair count: 1 mm topology-preserving simplification passes original fidelity and reduces 82140 pairs to 1029. It still fails topology and separation. This is not an adopted cleaning stage or a feasible full-group witness.

neighbor_clearance_experiment.scope: Sufficient neighboring-clearance inequalities inside the existing parallel-displacement convex proposal. No new repair stage, tolerance, work cap, checker or production-cleaner change.
neighbor_clearance_experiment.timing_scope: Single summed group-time samples; tests overlapped the start. Not a controlled timing comparison.
neighbor_clearance_experiment.mesh_scope: Direct flat coverage with surrounding ground, same pinned dtcc-mesher and options as prior handoffs. Not a production surface-mesh rerun.

uncompressed_trial.decision: Superseded: duplicate relative-displacement inequalities exhausted the unchanged row cap. No alternate implementation retained.

neighbor_clearance_experiment.decision: Retain the neighboring-clearance correction as research: 507/538, three gains and no losses, with all prior graph/route repairs retained and four complete cities meshed. The 90.5% measured runtime increase is a serious research performance limitation, not accepted production performance. Next derive whole-chain replacement under the same original fidelity and progress authority; do not increase caps or add fallback stages. Production promotion remains unestablished.

one_dense_constraint_profile.scope: First nonzero-direction motion support at the saved previous Uppsala 11 final state, cProfile sample. Diagnostic only; not a whole-construction timing.

performance_observation.interpretation: The bounded solver representation removes duplicate rows, but pair enumeration and repeated construction on densely sampled boundaries remain expensive. Whole-chain replacement is the next construction checkpoint.
